fields.Name: IT23 - RLS Client Smart-Cache Isolation
fields.Description: The client-transport companion to IT06 (rls-isolation): RLS7 proves the GraphQLDataProvider smart-cache does not cross-serve RLS-scoped rows between users. Runs the 'rls-isolation-client' bundle against a running MJAPI via GraphQLDataProvider; requires a separately-running MJAPI + MJ_API_KEY. CI provisioning of MJAPI is deferred (like IT03 / IT15), so this test is seeded Skip on the DB-only deterministic suite membership; it skips-as-pass when MJAPI is unreachable.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Over the GraphQL transport, a user's RLS-scoped read is never served another user's cached rows (smart-cache validation).
